docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
SDA requires Python 3.14 or later. With Conda installed, use the commands below to create a python environment and install SDA with its dependencies.

LinuxWindows

Open a terminal, then run:

conda create --name sda python=3.14
conda activate sda
python -m pip install "https://github.com/FlavienMattern/sda/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"

From the Start menu, open Anaconda Prompt, then run:

conda create --name sda python=3.14
conda activate sda
python -m pip install "https://github.com/FlavienMattern/sda/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"

Download seismic waveforms and StationXML metadata with ObsPy's MassDownloader. Most parameters are passed directly to MassDownloader; see the ObsPy usage examples for more details. Waveforms and inventories are stored under <dataPath>/waveforms and <dataPath>/inventory, unless custom paths are provided.

outputPath str Required

Project output directory, created if necessary.

dataPath str | None Default: None

Dataset directory; None uses <outputPath>/data.

domainType str Default: 'rectangular'

Geographic selection: "rectangular", "circular" or "global".

latitudes tuple[float, float] Default: (None, None)

Latitude bounds in degrees for a rectangular domain, e.g. (40.0, 45.0).

longitudes tuple[float, float] Default: (None, None)

Longitude bounds in degrees for a rectangular domain, e.g. (-120.0, -115.0).

latitude float | None Default: None

Center latitude in degrees for a circular domain.

longitude float | None Default: None

Center longitude in degrees for a circular domain.

minradius float | None Default: None

Inner radius of a circular domain, in angular degrees, e.g. 0.0. Required for a circular domain.

maxradius float | None Default: None

Outer radius of a circular domain, in angular degrees, e.g. 1.0. Required for a circular domain.

starttime str | UTCDateTime Default: None

UTC start of the waveform request, e.g. "2023-01-01T00:00:00". Must be provided for a defined request period.

endtime str | UTCDateTime Default: None

UTC end of the waveform request, e.g. "2023-01-02T00:00:00". Must be provided for a defined request period.

station_starttime str | UTCDateTime | None Default: None

Start of the StationXML metadata period; None uses starttime. May extend earlier than the waveform request.

station_endtime str | UTCDateTime | None Default: None

End of the StationXML metadata period; None uses endtime. May extend later than the waveform request.

chunklength_in_sec float | None Default: None

Duration of each download segment in seconds, e.g. 86400 for daily files. None requests the whole period as one segment.

network str | None Default: None

FDSN network selector, e.g. "IU" or "IU,G*"; None leaves networks unrestricted.

station str | None Default: None

FDSN station selector, e.g. "ANMO" or "A*"; None leaves stations unrestricted.

location str | None Default: None

FDSN location selector, e.g. "00" or "00,10"; None uses location_priorities.

channel str | None Default: None

FDSN channel selector, e.g. "BHZ" or "BH*"; None uses channel_priorities.

exclude_networks tuple[str, ...] | list[str] Default: tuple()

Network patterns to exclude, e.g. ["BW", "G*"]. An empty sequence excludes none.

exclude_stations tuple[str, ...] | list[str] Default: tuple()

Station patterns to exclude, e.g. ["STR", "AL??"]. An empty sequence excludes none.

limit_stations_to_inventory Inventory | None Default: None

Restrict downloads to stations in this ObsPy inventory, while keeping all other selection criteria.

reject_channels_with_gaps bool Default: True

Reject downloaded waveform files containing gaps or overlaps.

minimum_length float Default: 0.9

Minimum accepted data coverage as a fraction of the requested segment, between 0 and 1; 0.9 requires at least 90% coverage.

sanitize bool Default: True

Delete downloaded waveform files that have no associated StationXML metadata.

minimum_interstation_distance_in_m float Default: 1000

Minimum separation in meters between newly selected and already selected stations, also used to detect duplicates.

channel_priorities tuple[str, ...] | list[str] Default: ('HH[ZNE12]', 'BH[ZNE12]', 'MH[ZNE12]', 'EH[ZNE12]', 'LH[ZNE12]', 'HL[ZNE12]', 'BL[ZNE12]', 'ML[ZNE12]', 'EL[ZNE12]', 'LL[ZNE12]', 'SH[ZNE12]')

Preferred channel patterns, in order, e.g. ["HH[ZNE]", "BH[ZNE]"]. Ignored when channel is set.

location_priorities tuple[str, ...] | list[str] Default: ('', '00', '10', '01', '20', '02', '30', '03', '40', '04', '50', '05', '60', '06', '70', '07', '80', '08', '90', '09')

Preferred location codes, in order, e.g. ["", "00", "10"]. Ignored when location is set.

providers list[str | Client] | None Default: None

FDSN provider names, service URLs or configured ObsPy clients, e.g. ["RESIF"]. None tries all providers known to ObsPy.

debug bool Default: False

Enable detailed MassDownloader logging.

configure_logging bool Default: True

Let MassDownloader configure its console logger.

mseed_storage str | callable | None Default: None

Waveform storage template. None uses <dataPath>/waveforms/NET/STA/NET.STA.LOC.CHA/YYYY-MM-DD.mseed.

stationxml_storage str | callable | None Default: None

StationXML storage template. None uses <dataPath>/inventory/{network}/{station}.xml.

download_chunk_size_in_mb float Default: 20

Target size in megabytes of each bundled waveform download request; distinct from the time segmentation above.

threads_per_client int Default: 3

Number of simultaneous waveform download threads per provider.

print_report bool Default: True

Print the MassDownloader summary after downloading.

Notes
  • Existing waveform paths are skipped by the default storage template.
  • This function writes files (waveforms and metadata) and does not return a dataset object.
Example

Download daily vertical-component files for a rectangular region:

from sda.process import download_data

download_data(
    outputPath="/path/to/output",
    domainType="rectangular",
    latitudes=(40.0, 45.0),
    longitudes=(-120.0, -115.0),
    starttime="2023-01-01T00:00:00",
    endtime="2023-01-03T00:00:00",
    chunklength_in_sec=86400,
    network="TA",
    channel="BHZ",
)

Select stations within one degree of a point:

from sda.process import download_data

download_data(
    outputPath="/path/to/output",
    domainType="circular",
    latitude=48.58,
    longitude=7.75,
    minradius=0.0,
    maxradius=1.0,
    starttime="2023-01-01T00:00:00",
    endtime="2023-01-02T00:00:00",
    chunklength_in_sec=86400,
    providers=["RESIF"],
    channel="HHZ",
)

def download_data(
        outputPath,
        dataPath=None,

        # Domain definitions
        domainType="rectangular", # ["circular", "rectangular", "global"]
        latitudes=(None,None), # (latmin, latmax) Tuple of Min/Max latitude for Rectangular domain
        longitudes=(None,None), # (lomin, lonmax) Tuple of Min/Max longitude for Rectangular domain
        latitude=None, # Center latitude for Circular domain
        longitude=None, # Center longitude for Circular domain
        minradius=None, # [km] Minimum distance from center of Circular domain
        maxradius=None, # [km] Maximum distance from center of Circular domain

        # Resctrictions
        starttime=None, endtime=None,
        station_starttime=None, station_endtime=None,
        chunklength_in_sec=None,
        network=None, station=None, location=None, channel=None,
        exclude_networks=tuple(), exclude_stations=tuple(),
        limit_stations_to_inventory=None,
        reject_channels_with_gaps=True, minimum_length=0.9,
        sanitize=True, minimum_interstation_distance_in_m=1000,
        channel_priorities=("HH[ZNE12]", "BH[ZNE12]",
                            "MH[ZNE12]", "EH[ZNE12]",
                            "LH[ZNE12]", "HL[ZNE12]",
                            "BL[ZNE12]", "ML[ZNE12]",
                            "EL[ZNE12]", "LL[ZNE12]",
                            "SH[ZNE12]"),
        location_priorities=("", "00", "10", "01", "20", "02", "30",
                            "03", "40", "04", "50", "05", "60",
                            "06", "70", "07", "80", "08", "90",
                            "09"),

        # Massive Downloader object
        providers=None, # List of known providers (e.g. ["RESIF", "IRIS"]). None: to consider all known providers
        # It can be a list of client manually defined:
        # my_client = Client("RESIF", user="username", password="pwd")
        # providers = [my_client, "IRIS", ...]
        debug=False, configure_logging=True,

        # Download properties
        mseed_storage=None, # "DATA_PATH/waveforms/{network}/{station}/{location}/{channel}/{starttime}_{endtime}.mseed"
        stationxml_storage=None,
        download_chunk_size_in_mb=20, threads_per_client=3,
        print_report=True

    ):
    """Download seismic waveforms and StationXML metadata with ObsPy's MassDownloader.
    Most parameters are passed directly to MassDownloader;
    see the [ObsPy usage examples](https://docs.obspy.org/packages/autogen/obspy.clients.fdsn.mass_downloader.html#usage-examples)
    for more details.
    Waveforms and inventories are stored under `<dataPath>/waveforms` and
    `<dataPath>/inventory`, unless custom paths are provided.

    Parameters:
        outputPath (str): Project output directory, created if necessary.
        dataPath (str | None): Dataset directory; `None` uses `<outputPath>/data`.
        domainType (str): Geographic selection: `"rectangular"`, `"circular"` or `"global"`.
        latitudes (tuple[float, float]): Latitude bounds in degrees for a rectangular domain,
            e.g. `(40.0, 45.0)`.
        longitudes (tuple[float, float]): Longitude bounds in degrees for a rectangular domain,
            e.g. `(-120.0, -115.0)`.
        latitude (float | None): Center latitude in degrees for a circular domain.
        longitude (float | None): Center longitude in degrees for a circular domain.
        minradius (float | None): Inner radius of a circular domain, in angular degrees,
            e.g. `0.0`. Required for a circular domain.
        maxradius (float | None): Outer radius of a circular domain, in angular degrees,
            e.g. `1.0`. Required for a circular domain.
        starttime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC start of the waveform request,
            e.g. `"2023-01-01T00:00:00"`. Must be provided for a defined request period.
        endtime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC end of the waveform request,
            e.g. `"2023-01-02T00:00:00"`. Must be provided for a defined request period.
        station_starttime (str | UTCDateTime | None): Start of the StationXML metadata period;
            `None` uses `starttime`. May extend earlier than the waveform request.
        station_endtime (str | UTCDateTime | None): End of the StationXML metadata period;
            `None` uses `endtime`. May extend later than the waveform request.
        chunklength_in_sec (float | None): Duration of each download segment in seconds,
            e.g. `86400` for daily files. `None` requests the whole period as one segment.
        network (str | None): FDSN network selector, e.g. `"IU"` or `"IU,G*"`;
            `None` leaves networks unrestricted.
        station (str | None): FDSN station selector, e.g. `"ANMO"` or `"A*"`;
            `None` leaves stations unrestricted.
        location (str | None): FDSN location selector, e.g. `"00"` or `"00,10"`;
            `None` uses `location_priorities`.
        channel (str | None): FDSN channel selector, e.g. `"BHZ"` or `"BH*"`;
            `None` uses `channel_priorities`.
        exclude_networks (tuple[str, ...] | list[str]): Network patterns to exclude,
            e.g. `["BW", "G*"]`. An empty sequence excludes none.
        exclude_stations (tuple[str, ...] | list[str]): Station patterns to exclude,
            e.g. `["STR", "AL??"]`. An empty sequence excludes none.
        limit_stations_to_inventory (Inventory | None): Restrict downloads to stations in this
            ObsPy inventory, while keeping all other selection criteria.
        reject_channels_with_gaps (bool): Reject downloaded waveform files containing gaps
            or overlaps.
        minimum_length (float): Minimum accepted data coverage as a fraction of the requested
            segment, between `0` and `1`; `0.9` requires at least 90% coverage.
        sanitize (bool): Delete downloaded waveform files that have no associated StationXML
            metadata.
        minimum_interstation_distance_in_m (float): Minimum separation in meters between
            newly selected and already selected stations, also used to detect duplicates.
        channel_priorities (tuple[str, ...] | list[str]): Preferred channel patterns, in order,
            e.g. `["HH[ZNE]", "BH[ZNE]"]`. Ignored when `channel` is set.
        location_priorities (tuple[str, ...] | list[str]): Preferred location codes, in order,
            e.g. `["", "00", "10"]`. Ignored when `location` is set.
        providers (list[str | Client] | None): FDSN provider names, service URLs or configured
            ObsPy clients, e.g. `["RESIF"]`. `None` tries all providers known to ObsPy.
        debug (bool): Enable detailed MassDownloader logging.
        configure_logging (bool): Let MassDownloader configure its console logger.
        mseed_storage (str | callable | None): Waveform storage template.
            `None` uses `<dataPath>/waveforms/NET/STA/NET.STA.LOC.CHA/YYYY-MM-DD.mseed`.
        stationxml_storage (str | callable | None): StationXML storage template.
            `None` uses `<dataPath>/inventory/{network}/{station}.xml`.
        download_chunk_size_in_mb (float): Target size in megabytes of each bundled waveform
            download request; distinct from the time segmentation above.
        threads_per_client (int): Number of simultaneous waveform download threads per provider.
        print_report (bool): Print the MassDownloader summary after downloading.

    Notes:
        - Existing waveform paths are skipped by the default storage template.
        - This function writes files (waveforms and metadata) and does not return a dataset object.

    Example:
        Download daily vertical-component files for a rectangular region:

        ```python
        from sda.process import download_data

        download_data(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            domainType="rectangular",
            latitudes=(40.0, 45.0),
            longitudes=(-120.0, -115.0),
            starttime="2023-01-01T00:00:00",
            endtime="2023-01-03T00:00:00",
            chunklength_in_sec=86400,
            network="TA",
            channel="BHZ",
        )
        ```

        Select stations within one degree of a point:

        ```python
        from sda.process import download_data

        download_data(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            domainType="circular",
            latitude=48.58,
            longitude=7.75,
            minradius=0.0,
            maxradius=1.0,
            starttime="2023-01-01T00:00:00",
            endtime="2023-01-02T00:00:00",
            chunklength_in_sec=86400,
            providers=["RESIF"],
            channel="HHZ",
        )
        ```
    """

    add_log("#"*50, level="info")
    add_log("Start process: download_data", level="info")

    if not os.path.isdir(outputPath): os.makedirs(outputPath)

    # Prepare files
    if dataPath == None:
        dataPath = os.path.join(outputPath, "data")


    # Define geographical domain
    if domainType == "rectangular":
        domain = mdl.RectangularDomain(minlatitude=min(latitudes), maxlatitude=max(latitudes),
                                       minlongitude=min(longitudes), maxlongitude=max(longitudes))
    elif domainType == "circular":
        domain = mdl.CircularDomain(latitude=latitude, longitude=longitude,
                                    minradius=minradius, maxradius=maxradius)
    elif domainType == "global":
        domain = mdl.GlobalDomain()  

    # Restrictions
    starttime = UTCDateTime(starttime)
    endtime   = UTCDateTime(endtime)
    restrictions = mdl.Restrictions(
        starttime, endtime,
        station_starttime, station_endtime,
        chunklength_in_sec,
        network, station, location, channel,
        exclude_networks, exclude_stations,
        limit_stations_to_inventory,
        reject_channels_with_gaps, minimum_length,
        sanitize, minimum_interstation_distance_in_m,
        channel_priorities, location_priorities
    )

    # Massive Downloader object
    mdlObject = mdl.MassDownloader(providers, debug, configure_logging)

    # Download data
    global dataPathGlobalVariable # To be accessed by get_mseed_storage()
    dataPathGlobalVariable = dataPath
    if mseed_storage == None:
        mseed_storage = get_mseed_storage
    if stationxml_storage == None:
        stationxml_storage = os.path.join(dataPath, "inventory", "{network}", "{station}.xml")

    mdlObject.download(
        domain, restrictions,
        mseed_storage, stationxml_storage,
        download_chunk_size_in_mb, threads_per_client, print_report 
    )

    add_log("End process: download_data", level="info")
    add_log("#"*50, level="info")

scan_data(outputPath, dataPath=None, databasePath=None, overwrite=True, NumberOfProcesses=1, chunk_size=100)

Index waveform file headers in a SQLite database by recursively scanning the dataset, skipping XML files, and storing one metadata record per waveform file.

outputPath str Required

Project output directory, created if necessary.

dataPath str | None Default: None

Dataset directory to scan; None uses <outputPath>/data, the default dataset location used by download_data.

databasePath str | None Default: None

SQLite database file; None uses <outputPath>/database.db. Missing parent directories are created.

overwrite bool Default: True

Delete and rebuild the database when True. When False, keep existing records, add new ones and remove records for files no longer present.

NumberOfProcesses int Default: 1

Not used anymore. To be removed in future versions.

chunk_size int Default: 100

Number of readable files buffered before each database insert, e.g. 100.

Notes
  • Each record contains the absolute file path, station/channel identifiers, sampling information and time coverage.
  • With overwrite=False, detecting any new file currently triggers a scan of all files, which can duplicate existing records. Use overwrite=True for a clean rebuild, including after changing files without changing their paths. This will be corrected in a future version.
Example

Index a dataset downloaded into the default directory (with download_data):

from sda.process import scan_data

scan_data(outputPath="/path/to/output")

Index a dataset downloaded from custom directories:

scan_data(outputPath="/path/to/output", dataPath="/path/to/waveforms")

def scan_data(outputPath, dataPath=None, databasePath=None, overwrite=True, NumberOfProcesses=1, chunk_size=100):
    """Index waveform file headers in a SQLite database by recursively scanning the dataset,
    skipping XML files, and storing one metadata record per waveform file.

    Parameters:
        outputPath (str): Project output directory, created if necessary.
        dataPath (str | None): Dataset directory to scan; `None` uses `<outputPath>/data`,
            the default dataset location used by `download_data`.
        databasePath (str | None): SQLite database file; `None` uses
            `<outputPath>/database.db`. Missing parent directories are created.
        overwrite (bool): Delete and rebuild the database when `True`. When `False`,
            keep existing records, add new ones and remove records for files no longer present.
        NumberOfProcesses (int): Not used anymore. To be removed in future versions.
        chunk_size (int): Number of readable files buffered before each database insert, e.g. `100`.

    Notes:
        - Each record contains the absolute file path, station/channel identifiers,
          sampling information and time coverage.
        - With `overwrite=False`, detecting any new file currently triggers a scan of
          all files, which can duplicate existing records. Use `overwrite=True` for a
          clean rebuild, including after changing files without changing their paths.
          This will be corrected in a future version.

    Example:
        Index a dataset downloaded into the default directory (with `download_data`):

        ```python
        from sda.process import scan_data

        scan_data(outputPath="/path/to/output")
        ```

        Index a dataset downloaded from custom directories:

        ```python
        scan_data(outputPath="/path/to/output", dataPath="/path/to/waveforms")
        ```
    """

    add_log("#"*50, level="info")
    add_log("Start process: scan_data", level="info")

    # Prepare files
    if not os.path.isdir(outputPath):
        add_log(f"Output directory (outputPath = {outputPath}) doesn't exists. Creating the directory...", level="warning")
        os.makedirs(outputPath)

    if dataPath == None:
        dataPath = os.path.join(outputPath, "data")
    add_log(f"Dataset directory: {dataPath}", level="info")
    if not os.path.isdir(dataPath):
        add_log(f"Dataset directory (dataPath = {dataPath}) doesn't exists.", level="error")

    if databasePath == None:
        databasePath = os.path.join(outputPath, "database.db")
    add_log(f"Database file: {databasePath}", level="info")


    # Regarde si la base de données est déjà existante
    folder, filename = os.path.split(databasePath)
    if (folder != "") and (not os.path.isdir(folder)):
        add_log(f"Database folder ({folder}) doesn't exists. Creating the folder...", level="warning")
        os.makedirs(folder)

    if overwrite:
        add_log(f"Removing existing database file: {databasePath}", level="info")
        try:
            os.remove(databasePath)
        except OSError:
            add_log(f"No existing database file to remove. Ignoring.", level="warning")
            pass

    # Initialiser la base de données
    add_log("Initialize database.", level="info")
    initialize_database(databasePath)

    # Lister tous les fichiers dans l'arborescence
    add_log("Listing all existing files in dataset...", level="info")
    existing_files = set()
    for dirpath, _, filenames in os.walk(dataPath):
        for filename in filenames:
            if filename.lower().endswith(('.xml',)):
                continue
            absolutePath = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(dirpath, filename))
            existing_files.add(absolutePath)


    # Track changes in dataset
    Nremoved = remove_deleted_files_from_db(databasePath, existing_files)
    Nadded = added_files_in_db(databasePath, existing_files)
    Nunchanged = all_files_in_db(databasePath) - Nremoved
    print(datetime.now().strftime("[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S]") + f" File changes    : {Nadded} added | {Nremoved} removed | {Nunchanged} unchanged.")
    add_log(f"Track file changes : {Nadded} added | {Nremoved} removed | {Nunchanged} unchanged.", level="info")

    # Liste pour stocker les futures
    futures = []

    if Nadded == 0:
        print(datetime.now().strftime("[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S]") + " No new file to add in database.")
        add_log("No new file to add in database.", level="info")
    else:

        add_log(f"Processing {Nadded} new files to add to database...", level="info")
        data_chunk = []
        for file_path in tqdm(existing_files, desc=datetime.now().strftime("[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S]") + " Scan dataset    ", bar_format="{l_bar}{bar:30}{r_bar}"):
            result = extract_file_properties(file_path)
            if result:
                data_chunk.append(result)
                if len(data_chunk) >= chunk_size:
                    add_log(f"Inserting chunk of {len(data_chunk)} entries to database...", level="info")
                    bulk_insert(databasePath, data_chunk)
                    data_chunk = []

        # Ajouter le dernier chunk
        if data_chunk:
            bulk_insert(databasePath, data_chunk)

        add_log("All files added to the database.", level="info")

        # with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=NumberOfProcesses) as executor, tqdm(total=Nadded) as pbar:
        #     pbar.set_description("Scanning dataset   ")

        #     with sqlite3.connect(databasePath) as conn:
        #         cursor = conn.cursor()
        #         cursor.execute("SELECT FILE FROM DATASET")
        #         db_files = {row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()}

        #     for file_path in existing_files:
        #         if file_path not in db_files:
        #             futures.append(executor.submit(extract_file_properties, file_path, merge_update))

        #     # Récupérer les résultats et les stocker en base de données par chunks
        #     data_chunk = []
        #     for future in as_completed(futures):
        #         result = future.result()
        #         if result:
        #             data_chunk.append(result)
        #             if len(data_chunk) >= chunk_size:
        #                 bulk_insert(databasePath, data_chunk)
        #                 data_chunk = []
        #         pbar.update(1)

        #     # Ajouter le dernier chunk
        #     if data_chunk:
        #         bulk_insert(databasePath, data_chunk)

    add_log("End process: scan_data", level="info")
    add_log("#"*50, level="info")

xcorr_noise(outputPath, starttime, endtime, databasePath=None, DataPath=None, Components=['Z'], CrossComponents=['ZZ'], stations=[], NumberOfProcesses=1, doScan=True, remove_response=True, inventory_path=None, water_level=60, response_prefilt=(0.05, 0.06, 7.0, 9.0), NewFrequence=20, numberOfSubTrace=12, freqMin=1 / 10, freqMax=5, freqmin=0.05, factorTestStd=10, numberOfStd=3, factorReplaceWithStd=0, Convergence=False, ratioZero=9.0 / 10.0, ratioE=2, do1bit=None, factorTestStdSeisme=2, divideFreq=0.05, lengthBorder=100, HourFilter=(0, 24), AutoCorr=True, Maxlag=120, LenTrace=86400, minSubCorrKeep=0.8, maxInterDistance=None, savePreProcessing=False, restricted_times=None, save_mode='stack')

Preprocess seismic waveforms and compute ambient-noise correlations. Correlation functions are stored in HDF5 files at <outputPath>/xcorr_noise/<component>/<sta1>-<sta2>.h5. Waveform paths and metadata must first be indexed with scan_data.

outputPath str Required

Project directory containing the dataset and database, and receiving the xcorr_noise results directory.

starttime str | UTCDateTime Required

UTC start, including a time of day if needed, e.g. "2023-01-01", "2023-01-01T06:00:00".

endtime str | UTCDateTime Required

UTC end, including a time of day if needed, e.g. "2023-01-02", "2023-01-02T00:00:00".

databasePath str | None Default: None

Existing SQLite database created by scan_data; None uses <outputPath>/database.db (default location).

DataPath str | None Default: None

Waveform directory supplied to preprocessing; None uses <outputPath>/data/waveforms.

Components list[str] Default: ['Z']

Waveform components to preprocess, e.g. ["Z"] or ["Z", "N", "E"].

CrossComponents list[str] Default: ['ZZ']

Component pairs to correlate, e.g. ["ZZ"] or ["ZZ", "ZN", "NZ"]. The first letter refers to the first station.

stations list[str] Default: []

Station codes to include, e.g. ["ST01", "ST02"]. An empty list uses all stations.

NumberOfProcesses int Default: 1

Number of worker processes, distributed across LenTrace intervals.

doScan bool Default: True

Rebuild daily trace dictionaries from the existing SQLite index. False reuses <outputPath>/xcorr_noise/DictsOfTraces; it does not index new files.

remove_response bool Default: True

Remove the instrument response using StationXML metadata during preprocessing.

inventory_path str | None Default: None

Directory searched recursively for StationXML .xml files; None uses <outputPath>/data/inventory. Needed for response removal or an inter-station distance limit.

water_level float | None Default: 60

Water level in dB passed to ObsPy response removal; None disables water-level stabilization. Used only with remove_response=True.

response_prefilt tuple[float, float, float, float] | None Default: (0.05, 0.06, 7.0, 9.0)

Four response-removal taper corners in Hz, e.g. (0.05, 0.06, 7.0, 9.0); None disables this pre-filter.

NewFrequence float Default: 20

Target sampling rate in Hz after resampling, e.g. 20.

numberOfSubTrace int Default: 12

Number of equal sub-windows per LenTrace interval, e.g. 12 gives two-hour sub-windows for a one-day interval.

freqMin float Default: 1 / 10

Lower frequency in Hz for spectral whitening (which also acts as a band-pass filter).

freqMax float Default: 5

Upper frequency in Hz for spectral whitening (which also acts as a band-pass filter).

freqmin float Default: 0.05

High-pass corner in Hz applied before glitch correction; distinct from the whitening bound freqMin.

factorTestStd float Default: 10

Glitch threshold as a multiple of the trace standard deviation, e.g. 10 detects samples above ten standard deviations.

numberOfStd int Default: 3

Number of glitch-correction passes when Convergence=False; the standard deviation is recalculated at each pass.

factorReplaceWithStd float Default: 0

Replacement amplitude for glitches, as a multiple of the current standard deviation, preserving sign. 0 replaces them with zeros.

Convergence bool Default: False

Repeat glitch correction until stable, with an iteration limit. When False, perform exactly numberOfStd passes.

ratioZero float Default: 9.0 / 10.0

Minimum fraction of samples with valid data (not gaps) for a sub-window to pass the coverage test; 0.9 requires 90%.

ratioE float Default: 2

Multiplier of the interval's estimated mean sub-window energy. Sub-windows above this energy threshold are rejected.

do1bit str | None Default: None

Apply sign normalization "before_whiten" or "after_whiten"; None disables it.

factorTestStdSeisme float Default: 2

Amplitude-clipping factor applied after whitening, relative to the sub-window standard deviation.

divideFreq float Default: 0.05

Fraction of the whitening bandwidth tapered at each edge, e.g. 0.05 for 5% per edge. Use a value between 0 and 0.5.

lengthBorder int Default: 100

Compatibility option; currently unused by preprocessing. To be removed in a future version.

HourFilter tuple[float, float] Default: (0, 24)

Accepted UTC hours. (0, 24) keeps all hours; (22, 6) spans midnight.

AutoCorr bool Default: True

Compatibility option; currently ignored. Same-station pairs are included regardless of this value. To be changed in a future version.

Maxlag float Default: 120

Maximum absolute correlation lag in seconds, e.g. 120 saves the range from -120 to +120 seconds.

LenTrace float Default: 86400

Length in seconds of each consecutive, non-overlapping processing interval. The intervals start at starttime; an incomplete final interval is skipped.

minSubCorrKeep float Default: 0.8

Minimum fraction of retained sub-windows for a valid stack, between 0 and 1. Ignored when save_mode="full".

maxInterDistance float | None Default: None

Maximum station-pair distance in kilometers, computed from the inventory. None applies no distance limit.

savePreProcessing bool Default: False

Keep the preprocessed NumPy traces after correlation; otherwise their temporary directories are removed.

restricted_times list[tuple[str, str]] | None Default: None

Allowed UTC intervals. A sub-window must fit entirely inside one interval, e.g. [("2023-01-01T00:00:00", "2023-01-01T06:00:00")]. None or an empty list applies no additional time restriction.

save_mode str Default: 'stack'

"stack" saves the mean of retained sub-correlations per interval; "full" saves every retained sub-correlation.

Notes
  • Whitening is applied only to cross-correlations; it is replaced by a band-pass filter for autocorrelations.
Example

Compute daily vertical-component correlations after indexing the dataset:

from sda.process import xcorr_noise

xcorr_noise(
    outputPath="/path/to/output",
    starttime="2023-01-01",
    endtime="2023-01-03",
    NumberOfProcesses=4,
    inventory_path="/path/to/output/data/inventory",
    remove_response=True,
    doScan=True,
    LenTrace=86400,
    numberOfSubTrace=48,
    Components=["Z"],
    CrossComponents=["ZZ"],
    stations=["ST01", "ST02"],

)

Save individual five-minute correlations within hourly intervals:

xcorr_noise(
    outputPath="/path/to/output",
    starttime="2023-01-01T00:00:00",
    endtime="2023-01-03T00:00:00",
    NumberOfProcesses=4,
    inventory_path="/path/to/output/data/inventory",
    remove_response=True,
    doScan=True,
    LenTrace=3600,
    numberOfSubTrace=12,
    Components=["Z"],
    CrossComponents=["ZZ"],
    stations=["ST01", "ST02"],
    save_mode="full",
)

def xcorr_noise(
    outputPath,
    starttime,
    endtime,
    databasePath = None,
    DataPath = None,
    Components = ["Z"], # ["Z"]
    CrossComponents = ["ZZ"], # ["ZZ"]
    stations = [],
    NumberOfProcesses = 1,
    doScan = True,
    remove_response = True,
    inventory_path = None, # Absolute path
    water_level = 60,
    response_prefilt = (0.05, 0.06, 7.0, 9.0),
    NewFrequence = 20,
    numberOfSubTrace = 12,
    freqMin = 1/10,
    freqMax = 5,
    freqmin = 0.05,
    factorTestStd = 10,
    numberOfStd = 3, # Pas utilisé si Convergence = False ?
    factorReplaceWithStd = 0,
    Convergence = False,
    ratioZero = 9.0/10.0,
    ratioE = 2,
    do1bit = None,
    factorTestStdSeisme = 2,
    divideFreq = 0.05, # Whitening : The percentage of the length of the apodization of each border in the frequency domain : Between 0 (0%) and 0.5 (50% of the window on each side, so 100%)
    lengthBorder = 100, # Not used
    HourFilter = (0, 24),
    AutoCorr = True, # Do autocorr ? [ne marche pas, laisser en True sinon tout casse !!!]
    Maxlag = 120, # [s] Maximum absolute lagitme
    LenTrace = 86400, # [s] Length of Trace
    minSubCorrKeep = 0.8,
    maxInterDistance = None,
    savePreProcessing = False,
    restricted_times = None,
    save_mode = "stack"
):

    """Preprocess seismic waveforms and compute ambient-noise correlations.
    Correlation functions are stored in HDF5 files at `<outputPath>/xcorr_noise/<component>/<sta1>-<sta2>.h5`.
    Waveform paths and metadata must first be indexed with `scan_data`.

    Parameters:
        outputPath (str): Project directory containing the dataset and database, and receiving
            the `xcorr_noise` results directory.
        starttime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC start, including a time of day if needed,
            e.g. `"2023-01-01"`, `"2023-01-01T06:00:00"`.
        endtime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC end, including a time of day if needed,
            e.g. `"2023-01-02"`, `"2023-01-02T00:00:00"`.
        databasePath (str | None): Existing SQLite database created by `scan_data`;
            `None` uses `<outputPath>/database.db` (default location).
        DataPath (str | None): Waveform directory supplied to preprocessing;
            `None` uses `<outputPath>/data/waveforms`.
        Components (list[str]): Waveform components to preprocess, e.g. `["Z"]`
            or `["Z", "N", "E"]`.
        CrossComponents (list[str]): Component pairs to correlate, e.g. `["ZZ"]`
            or `["ZZ", "ZN", "NZ"]`. The first letter refers to the first station.
        stations (list[str]): Station codes to include, e.g. `["ST01", "ST02"]`.
            An empty list uses all stations.
        NumberOfProcesses (int): Number of worker processes, distributed across `LenTrace`
            intervals.
        doScan (bool): Rebuild daily trace dictionaries from the existing SQLite index.
            `False` reuses `<outputPath>/xcorr_noise/DictsOfTraces`; it does not index new files.
        remove_response (bool): Remove the instrument response using StationXML metadata
            during preprocessing.
        inventory_path (str | None): Directory searched recursively for StationXML `.xml`
            files; `None` uses `<outputPath>/data/inventory`. Needed for response removal
            or an inter-station distance limit.
        water_level (float | None): Water level in dB passed to ObsPy response removal;
            `None` disables water-level stabilization. Used only with `remove_response=True`.
        response_prefilt (tuple[float, float, float, float] | None): Four response-removal
            taper corners in Hz, e.g. `(0.05, 0.06, 7.0, 9.0)`; `None` disables this pre-filter.
        NewFrequence (float): Target sampling rate in Hz after resampling, e.g. `20`.
        numberOfSubTrace (int): Number of equal sub-windows per `LenTrace` interval,
            e.g. `12` gives two-hour sub-windows for a one-day interval.
        freqMin (float): Lower frequency in Hz for spectral whitening (which also acts as a band-pass filter).
        freqMax (float): Upper frequency in Hz for spectral whitening (which also acts as a band-pass filter).
        freqmin (float): High-pass corner in Hz applied before glitch correction;
            distinct from the whitening bound `freqMin`.
        factorTestStd (float): Glitch threshold as a multiple of the trace standard
            deviation, e.g. `10` detects samples above ten standard deviations.
        numberOfStd (int): Number of glitch-correction passes when `Convergence=False`;
            the standard deviation is recalculated at each pass.
        factorReplaceWithStd (float): Replacement amplitude for glitches, as a multiple of
            the current standard deviation, preserving sign. `0` replaces them with zeros.
        Convergence (bool): Repeat glitch correction until stable, with an iteration limit.
            When `False`, perform exactly `numberOfStd` passes.
        ratioZero (float): Minimum fraction of samples with valid data (not gaps) for a sub-window to pass the coverage test; `0.9` requires 90%.
        ratioE (float): Multiplier of the interval's estimated mean sub-window energy.
            Sub-windows above this energy threshold are rejected.
        do1bit (str | None): Apply sign normalization `"before_whiten"` or
            `"after_whiten"`; `None` disables it.
        factorTestStdSeisme (float): Amplitude-clipping factor applied after whitening,
            relative to the sub-window standard deviation.
        divideFreq (float): Fraction of the whitening bandwidth tapered at each edge,
            e.g. `0.05` for 5% per edge. Use a value between `0` and `0.5`.
        lengthBorder (int): Compatibility option; currently unused by preprocessing. To be removed in a future version.
        HourFilter (tuple[float, float]): Accepted UTC hours. `(0, 24)` keeps all hours; `(22, 6)` spans midnight.
        AutoCorr (bool): Compatibility option; currently ignored. Same-station pairs
            are included regardless of this value. To be changed in a future version.
        Maxlag (float): Maximum absolute correlation lag in seconds, e.g. `120` saves
            the range from `-120` to `+120` seconds.
        LenTrace (float): Length in seconds of each consecutive, non-overlapping processing
            interval. The intervals start at `starttime`; an incomplete final interval is skipped.
        minSubCorrKeep (float): Minimum fraction of retained sub-windows for a valid stack,
            between `0` and `1`. Ignored when `save_mode="full"`.
        maxInterDistance (float | None): Maximum station-pair distance in kilometers,
            computed from the inventory. `None` applies no distance limit.
        savePreProcessing (bool): Keep the preprocessed NumPy traces after correlation;
            otherwise their temporary directories are removed.
        restricted_times (list[tuple[str, str]] | None): Allowed UTC intervals. A sub-window
            must fit entirely inside one interval, e.g.
            `[("2023-01-01T00:00:00", "2023-01-01T06:00:00")]`.
            `None` or an empty list applies no additional time restriction.
        save_mode (str): `"stack"` saves the mean of retained sub-correlations per interval;
            `"full"` saves every retained sub-correlation.

    Notes:
        - Whitening is applied only to cross-correlations; it is replaced by a band-pass
          filter for autocorrelations.

    Example:
        Compute daily vertical-component correlations after indexing the dataset:

        ```python
        from sda.process import xcorr_noise

        xcorr_noise(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            starttime="2023-01-01",
            endtime="2023-01-03",
            NumberOfProcesses=4,
            inventory_path="/path/to/output/data/inventory",
            remove_response=True,
            doScan=True,
            LenTrace=86400,
            numberOfSubTrace=48,
            Components=["Z"],
            CrossComponents=["ZZ"],
            stations=["ST01", "ST02"],

        )
        ```

        Save individual five-minute correlations within hourly intervals:

        ```python
        xcorr_noise(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            starttime="2023-01-01T00:00:00",
            endtime="2023-01-03T00:00:00",
            NumberOfProcesses=4,
            inventory_path="/path/to/output/data/inventory",
            remove_response=True,
            doScan=True,
            LenTrace=3600,
            numberOfSubTrace=12,
            Components=["Z"],
            CrossComponents=["ZZ"],
            stations=["ST01", "ST02"],
            save_mode="full",
        )
        ```
    """

    add_log("#"*50, level="info")
    add_log("Start process: xcorr_noise", level="info")

    # Prepare files
    if not os.path.isdir(outputPath):
        add_log(f"Output directory (outputPath = {outputPath}) doesn't exists. Creating the directory...", level="warning")
        os.makedirs(outputPath)

    if DataPath == None:
        DataPath = os.path.join(outputPath, "data", "waveforms")
    add_log(f"Dataset folder: {DataPath}", level="info")

    if inventory_path == None:
        inventory_path = os.path.join(outputPath, "data", "inventory")
    add_log(f"Inventory folder: {inventory_path}", level="info")

    if databasePath == None:
        databasePath = os.path.join(outputPath, "database.db")
    add_log(f"Database file: {databasePath}", level="info")
    SaveDirectory = os.path.join(outputPath, "xcorr_noise")
    add_log(f"Save correlations directory: {SaveDirectory}", level="info")

    # Prepare config dictionary
    config = {
        "DataPath" : DataPath,
        "databasePath" : databasePath,
        "SaveDirectory" : SaveDirectory,
        "Components" : Components,
        "CrossComponents" : CrossComponents,
        "starttime" : starttime,
        "endtime" : endtime,
        "stations" : stations,
        "NumberOfProcesses": NumberOfProcesses,
        "doScan" : doScan,
        "remove_response" : remove_response,
        "inventory_path" : inventory_path,
        "water_level" : water_level,
        "response_prefilt" : response_prefilt,
        "NewFrequence" : NewFrequence,
        "numberOfSubTrace" : numberOfSubTrace,
        "freqMin" : freqMin,
        "freqMax" : freqMax,
        "freqmin" : freqmin,
        "factorTestStd" : factorTestStd,
        "numberOfStd" : numberOfStd,
        "factorReplaceWithStd" : factorReplaceWithStd,
        "Convergence" : Convergence,
        "ratioZero" : ratioZero,
        "ratioE" : ratioE,
        "do1bit" : do1bit,
        "factorTestStdSeisme" : factorTestStdSeisme,
        "divideFreq" : divideFreq,
        "lengthBorder" : lengthBorder,
        "HourFilter" : HourFilter,
        "AutoCorr" : AutoCorr,
        "Maxlag" : Maxlag,
        "LenTrace" : LenTrace,
        "NumberSubLen" : numberOfSubTrace,
        "minSubCorrKeep" : minSubCorrKeep,
        "maxInterDistance": maxInterDistance,
        "savePreProcessing": savePreProcessing,
        "restricted_times": restricted_times,
        "save_mode": save_mode
    }
    # Convert the requested UTC interval and durations; parameter validation is deferred.
    start_ns = starttime.ns if isinstance(starttime, UTCDateTime) else pd.Timestamp(starttime).value
    end_ns = endtime.ns if isinstance(endtime, UTCDateTime) else pd.Timestamp(endtime).value
    if isinstance(endtime, str) and len(endtime) == 10:
        end_ns += 86400 * 1_000_000_000
    config["range_start_ns"] = start_ns
    config["range_end_ns"] = end_ns
    config["window_duration_ns"] = round(LenTrace * 1_000_000_000)
    config["starttime"] = UTCDateTime(ns=(start_ns // 1_000_000_000) * 1_000_000_000).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    config["endtime"] = UTCDateTime(ns=((end_ns - 1) // 1_000_000_000) * 1_000_000_000).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    config = conf.update(config)
    config["LenTrace"] = round(config["LenTrace"])
    config["Maxlag"] = round(config["Maxlag"])
    config["GoodNumber"] = config["LenTrace"] // numberOfSubTrace + config["Maxlag"]
    add_log("Configuration parameters:", level="info")
    for key in config:
        add_log(f"  - {key} : {config[key]}", level="info")

    # Scan step
    config["ComponentStation"] = "Z"
    Scan.treatTracesFromDirectory(config)

    # PreProcessing + Correlation step
    Correlation(config)

    add_log("End process: xcorr_noise", level="info")
    add_log("#"*50, level="info")

xcorr_noise_monitoring(outputPath, starttime, endtime, NumberOfProcesses, refstarttime=None, refendtime=None, StackCount=1, stations=[], inventory_path=None, freqMinMonitoring=1, freqMaxMonitoring=4, RotationComponents=['ZZ'], LagtimeMonitoring=[(0, 20)], LagtimeVelocity=0, LagtimeShift=0, LagtimeWindowLength=50, LagtimeSide=None, maxInterDistance=None, doStretching=True, StretchingMax=0.06, StretchingNbTrial=100, doDoublet=False, DoubletWindowLength=10, DoubletWindowStep=5)

Estimate relative seismic velocity changes from post-processed noise correlations. Compare each selected correlation with a reference using stretching and/or moving-window cross-spectral analysis (MWCS). dv/v, coherence and errors are saved to <outputPath>/xcorr_noise_monitoring/<sta1>-<sta2>.h5.

outputPath str Required

Project directory containing outputs from xcorr_noise_postprocessing.

starttime str | UTCDateTime Required

UTC start for selecting correlation timestamps to monitor, e.g. "2023-02-01", "2023-02-01T15:00:00".

endtime str | UTCDateTime Required

UTC end for selecting correlation timestamps to monitor, e.g. "2023-02-02", "2023-02-02T00:00:00".

NumberOfProcesses int Required

Required number of worker processes, distributed across station pairs, e.g. 4.

refstarttime str | UTCDateTime | None Default: None

UTC start of the reference period. If set to None, consider all available correlations during the monitoring period.

refendtime str | UTCDateTime | None Default: None

UTC end of the reference period. If set to None, consider all available correlations during the monitoring period.

StackCount int Default: 1

Select an existing stack_<StackCount> from xcorr_noise_postprocessing, e.g. 10 reads stack_10. This function does not create stacks.

stations list[str] Default: []

Station codes to include, e.g. ["ST01", "ST02"]. An empty list considers all available stations.

inventory_path str | None Default: None

Directory searched recursively for StationXML .xml files; None uses <outputPath>/data/inventory. Required for rotation, velocity-based lag windows or distance filtering.

freqMinMonitoring float Default: 1

Lower band-pass corner in Hz for correlation functions.

freqMaxMonitoring float Default: 4

Upper band-pass corner in Hz for correlation functions.

RotationComponents list[str] | None Default: ['ZZ']

Components to retain or rotate into, e.g. ["ZZ", "RR", "TT"]. Horizontal rotation requires NN, NE, EN, EE. None or [] skips rotation and keeps all available ZNE component pairs.

LagtimeMonitoring list[tuple[float, float]] Default: [(0, 20)]

Manual lag windows in seconds, e.g. [(-40, -10), (10, 40)]. Used when LagtimeVelocity=0.

LagtimeVelocity float | list[float] Default: 0

Propagation speed in km/s for automatic windows: their start is distance / velocity + LagtimeShift, clipped to zero. 0 uses manual windows; a list defines several automatic windows.

LagtimeShift float | list[float] Default: 0

Offset in seconds added to each automatic window start. For a velocity list, provide a matching list; a zero velocity uses the shift alone.

LagtimeWindowLength float | list[float] Default: 50

Duration in seconds of each automatic lag window. For a velocity list, provide a matching list of durations.

LagtimeSide str | None Default: None

Side of automatic windows: "causal", "acausal", "both" or "fold"; None uses positive lags. "fold" also averages positive and mirrored negative lags before measurement, including with manual windows.

maxInterDistance float | None Default: None

Maximum station-pair distance in kilometers, computed from the inventory. None applies no distance limit.

doStretching bool Default: True

Estimate dv/v using the stretching method.

StretchingMax float Default: 0.06

Absolute bound of the stretching search, e.g. 0.06 searches from -6% to +6% velocity change. Used only with doStretching=True.

StretchingNbTrial int Default: 100

Number of trial stretching factors. Used only with doStretching=True.

doDoublet bool Default: False

Estimate dv/v using the MWCS method.

DoubletWindowLength float Default: 10

Sliding MWCS window duration in seconds; used only with doDoublet=True.

DoubletWindowStep float Default: 5

Step in seconds between successive MWCS windows; used only with doDoublet=True.

Notes
  • Run xcorr_noise_postprocessing first.
  • Saved dv/v values and their errors are percentages, not fractions.
Example

Measure stretching relative to a fixed reference period and fixed lag windows:

from sda.process import xcorr_noise_monitoring

xcorr_noise_monitoring(
    outputPath="/path/to/output",
    starttime="2023-01-01",
    endtime="2024-01-01",
    NumberOfProcesses=4,
    refstarttime="2023-01-01",
    refendtime="2023-03-01",
    RotationComponents=None,
    LagtimeMonitoring=[(-40, -10), (10, 40)],
    StretchingMax=0.03,
)

Measure stretching relative to a full reference period for data stacked over 10 time steps, using automatic lag windows based on interstation distance and velocity:

xcorr_noise_monitoring(
    outputPath="/path/to/output",
    starttime="2023-01-01",
    endtime="2024-01-01",
    NumberOfProcesses=4,
    StackCount=10,
    inventory_path="/path/to/output/data/inventory",
    RotationComponents=None,
    LagtimeVelocity=[1.0, 1.0],
    LagtimeShift=[10, 10],
    LagtimeWindowLength=[20, 20],
    LagtimeSide="both",
    doStretching=True,
    StretchingMax = 0.1,
    StretchingNbTrial = 70,
    doDoublet=True,
    DoubletWindowLength=5,
    DoubletWindowStep=2,
)

    outputPath,
    starttime,
    endtime,
    NumberOfProcesses,
    refstarttime = None,
    refendtime = None,
    StackCount = 1,
    stations = [],
    inventory_path = None,
    freqMinMonitoring = 1,
    freqMaxMonitoring = 4,
    RotationComponents = ["ZZ"],
    LagtimeMonitoring = [(0,20)],
    LagtimeVelocity = 0,
    LagtimeShift = 0,
    LagtimeWindowLength = 50,
    LagtimeSide = None,

    DoubletWindowStep = 5

    """Estimate relative seismic velocity changes from post-processed noise correlations.
    Compare each selected correlation with a reference using stretching and/or
    moving-window cross-spectral analysis (MWCS). dv/v, coherence and errors are
    saved to `<outputPath>/xcorr_noise_monitoring/<sta1>-<sta2>.h5`.

    Parameters:
        outputPath (str): Project directory containing outputs from `xcorr_noise_postprocessing`.
        starttime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC start for selecting correlation
            timestamps to monitor, e.g. `"2023-02-01"`, `"2023-02-01T15:00:00"`.
        endtime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC end for selecting correlation
            timestamps to monitor, e.g. `"2023-02-02"`, `"2023-02-02T00:00:00"`.
        NumberOfProcesses (int): Required number of worker processes, distributed across
            station pairs, e.g. `4`.
        refstarttime (str | UTCDateTime | None): UTC start of the reference period.
            If set to `None`, consider all available correlations during the monitoring period.
        refendtime (str | UTCDateTime | None): UTC end of the reference period.
            If set to `None`, consider all available correlations during the monitoring period.
        StackCount (int): Select an existing `stack_<StackCount>` from `xcorr_noise_postprocessing`,
            e.g. `10` reads `stack_10`. This function does not create stacks.
        stations (list[str]): Station codes to include, e.g. `["ST01", "ST02"]`.
            An empty list considers all available stations.
        inventory_path (str | None): Directory searched recursively for StationXML `.xml`
            files; `None` uses `<outputPath>/data/inventory`. Required for rotation,
            velocity-based lag windows or distance filtering.
        freqMinMonitoring (float): Lower band-pass corner in Hz for correlation functions.
        freqMaxMonitoring (float): Upper band-pass corner in Hz for correlation functions.
        RotationComponents (list[str] | None): Components to retain or rotate into,
            e.g. `["ZZ", "RR", "TT"]`. Horizontal rotation requires `NN`, `NE`, `EN`, `EE`.
            `None` or `[]` skips rotation and keeps all available ZNE component pairs.
        LagtimeMonitoring (list[tuple[float, float]]): Manual lag windows in seconds,
            e.g. `[(-40, -10), (10, 40)]`. Used when `LagtimeVelocity=0`.
        LagtimeVelocity (float | list[float]): Propagation speed in km/s for automatic windows:
            their start is `distance / velocity + LagtimeShift`, clipped to zero.
            `0` uses manual windows; a list defines several automatic windows.
        LagtimeShift (float | list[float]): Offset in seconds added to each automatic window
            start. For a velocity list, provide a matching list; a zero velocity uses the shift alone.
        LagtimeWindowLength (float | list[float]): Duration in seconds of each automatic lag
            window. For a velocity list, provide a matching list of durations.
        LagtimeSide (str | None): Side of automatic windows: `"causal"`, `"acausal"`,
            `"both"` or `"fold"`; `None` uses positive lags. `"fold"` also averages
            positive and mirrored negative lags before measurement, including with manual windows.
        maxInterDistance (float | None): Maximum station-pair distance in kilometers,
            computed from the inventory. `None` applies no distance limit.
        doStretching (bool): Estimate dv/v using the stretching method.
        StretchingMax (float): Absolute bound of the stretching search,
            e.g. `0.06` searches from -6% to +6% velocity change. Used only with `doStretching=True`.
        StretchingNbTrial (int): Number of trial stretching factors. Used only with `doStretching=True`.
        doDoublet (bool): Estimate dv/v using the MWCS method.
        DoubletWindowLength (float): Sliding MWCS window duration in seconds;
            used only with `doDoublet=True`.
        DoubletWindowStep (float): Step in seconds between successive MWCS windows;
            used only with `doDoublet=True`.

    Notes:
        - Run `xcorr_noise_postprocessing` first.
        - Saved dv/v values and their errors are percentages, not fractions.

    Example:
        Measure stretching relative to a fixed reference period and fixed lag windows:

        ```python
        from sda.process import xcorr_noise_monitoring

        xcorr_noise_monitoring(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            starttime="2023-01-01",
            endtime="2024-01-01",
            NumberOfProcesses=4,
            refstarttime="2023-01-01",
            refendtime="2023-03-01",
            RotationComponents=None,
            LagtimeMonitoring=[(-40, -10), (10, 40)],
            StretchingMax=0.03,
        )
        ```

        Measure stretching relative to a full reference period for data stacked over 10 time steps, using automatic lag windows based on interstation distance and velocity:

        ```python
        xcorr_noise_monitoring(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            starttime="2023-01-01",
            endtime="2024-01-01",
            NumberOfProcesses=4,
            StackCount=10,
            inventory_path="/path/to/output/data/inventory",
            RotationComponents=None,
            LagtimeVelocity=[1.0, 1.0],
            LagtimeShift=[10, 10],
            LagtimeWindowLength=[20, 20],
            LagtimeSide="both",
            doStretching=True,
            StretchingMax = 0.1,
            StretchingNbTrial = 70,
            doDoublet=True,
            DoubletWindowLength=5,
            DoubletWindowStep=2,
        )
        ```
    """

    add_log("#"*50, level="info")
    add_log("Start process: xcorr_noise_monitoring", level="info")

    if inventory_path == None:
        inventory_path = os.path.join(outputPath, "data", "inventory")    
    SaveDirectory = os.path.join(outputPath, "xcorr_noise")

    # Prepare config dictionary
    config = {
        "outputPath" : outputPath,
        "SaveDirectory" : SaveDirectory,
        "inventory_path" : inventory_path,
        "starttime" : starttime,
        "endtime" : endtime,
        "refstarttime" : refstarttime,
        "refendtime" : refendtime,
        "NumberOfProcesses": NumberOfProcesses,
        "StackCount" : StackCount,
        "stations" : stations,
        "freqMinMonitoring" : freqMinMonitoring,
        "freqMaxMonitoring" : freqMaxMonitoring,
        "RotationComponents" : RotationComponents,
        "LagtimeMonitoring" : LagtimeMonitoring,
        "LagtimeVelocity" : LagtimeVelocity,
        "LagtimeShift" : LagtimeShift,
        "LagtimeWindowLength" : LagtimeWindowLength,
        "LagtimeSide" : LagtimeSide,
        "maxInterDistance": maxInterDistance,
        "doStretching" : doStretching,
        "StretchingMax" : StretchingMax,
        "StretchingNbTrial" : StretchingNbTrial,
        "doDoublet" : doDoublet,
        "DoubletWindowLength" : DoubletWindowLength,
        "DoubletWindowStep" : DoubletWindowStep
    }
    add_log("Configuration parameters:", level="info")
    for key in config:
        add_log(f"  - {key} : {config[key]}", level="info")

    # Read inventory file
    inventory = None
    if (config["LagtimeVelocity"] != 0) or config["RotationComponents"] or (config["maxInterDistance"] is not None):
        for path, _, files in os.walk(config['inventory_path']):
            for name in files:
                if name[-4:] == ".xml":
                    invfile = os.path.join(path, name)
                    inv = read_inventory(invfile, format="STATIONXML")
                    if inventory is None:
                        inventory = inv
                    else:
                        inventory.extend(inv)

    os.makedirs(SaveDirectory, exist_ok=True)

    # Preparing inputs    
    couples = MakeCouplesOfStation(config)
    pairs = []
    for couple in couples:
        if len(config["stations"]) == 0:
            pair = (couple[0], couple[1])
            if pair not in pairs : pairs.append(pair)
        else:
            if (couple[0] in config["stations"]) and (couple[1] in config["stations"]):
                pair = (couple[0], couple[1])
                if pair not in pairs : pairs.append(pair)

    # Launching monitoring
    add_log("Starting ambient noise monitoring...", level="info")
    MonitoringPoolHandler(pairs, config, inventory)

    add_log("End process: xcorr_noise_monitoring", level="info")
    add_log("#"*50, level="info")

Apply an SVD-Wiener filter.

Number of singular components to retain. Used with doSVDWiener=True.

def xcorr_noise_postprocessing(
    outputPath,
    starttime,
    endtime,
    NumberOfProcesses=1,
    stations = [],
    doSVDWiener = False,
    SVDThreshold = 15,
    WienerFiltTime = 5,
    WienerFiltLagTime = 5,
    StackCount = 10,
    StackOverlap = 0,
):

    """Denoise correlation functions using an SVD-Wiener filter and/or stack correlation functions.
    Read outputs from `<outputPath>/xcorr_noise` and write HDF5 stacks to
    `<outputPath>/xcorr_noise_postprocessing/stack_<StackCount>/<component>/<sta1>-<sta2>.h5`.

    Parameters:
        outputPath (str): Project directory containing the `xcorr_noise` outputs.
        starttime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC start for selecting correlation
            timestamps to monitor, e.g. `"2023-02-01"`, `"2023-02-01T15:00:00"`.
        endtime (str | UTCDateTime): UTC end for selecting correlation
            timestamps to monitor, e.g. `"2023-02-02"`, `"2023-02-02T00:00:00"`.
        NumberOfProcesses (int): Number of worker processes, distributed across station pairs.
        stations (list[str]): Station codes to include, e.g. `["ST01", "ST02"]`.
            An empty list considers all available stations.
        doSVDWiener (bool): Apply an SVD-Wiener filter.
        SVDThreshold (int): Number of singular components to retain. Used with `doSVDWiener=True`.
        WienerFiltTime (int): Wiener window size along the time axis, in time steps.
            Used only with `doSVDWiener=True`.
        WienerFiltLagTime (int): Wiener window size along the lag axis, in samples.
            Used only with `doSVDWiener=True`.
        StackCount (int): Number of consecutive correlation records per stack, e.g. `10`.
            `1` does not apply stacking.
        StackOverlap (float): Overlap fraction between successive groups, between `0` and `1`.
            `0` gives disjoint groups; `0.5` gives half overlap.

    Example:
        Stack correlation functions over ten time steps, with no overlap between groups:

        ```python
        from sda.process import xcorr_noise_postprocessing

        xcorr_noise_postprocessing(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            starttime="2023-01-01",
            endtime="2023-02-01",
            NumberOfProcesses=4,
            StackCount=10,
            StackOverlap=0,
        )
        ```

        Apply an SVD-Wiener filter without any stacking:

        ```python
        xcorr_noise_postprocessing(
            outputPath="/path/to/output",
            starttime="2023-01-01",
            endtime="2023-04-01",
            NumberOfProcesses=4,
            doSVDWiener=True,
            SVDThreshold=5,
            WienerFiltTime=5,
            WienerFiltLagTime=5,
        )
        ```
    """

    add_log("#"*50, level="info")
    add_log("Start process: xcorr_noise_postprocessing", level="info")
    SaveDirectory = os.path.join(outputPath, "xcorr_noise")
    SaveDirectoryPostProcess = os.path.join(outputPath, "xcorr_noise_postprocessing")

    # Prepare config dictionary
    config = {
        "SaveDirectory" : SaveDirectory,
        "SaveDirectoryPostProcess" : SaveDirectoryPostProcess,
        "starttime" : starttime,
        "endtime" : endtime,
        "NumberOfProcesses": NumberOfProcesses,
        "stations" : stations,
        "doSVDWiener" : doSVDWiener,
        "SVDThreshold" : SVDThreshold,
        "WienerFiltTime" : WienerFiltTime,
        "WienerFiltLagTime" : WienerFiltLagTime,
        "StackCount" : StackCount,
        "StackOverlap" : StackOverlap,
    }
    add_log("Configuration parameters:", level="info")
    for key in config:
        add_log(f"  - {key} : {config[key]}", level="info")

    pairs = MakeCouplesOfStation(config)
    add_log("Starting postprocessing of ambient noise correlations...", level="info")

    # Run in multiprocessing
    PostProcessingParallelWithConfig = partial(PostProcessingPair, config=config)
    with get_context("loky").Pool(processes=config["NumberOfProcesses"], initializer=init_worker_logging,
              initargs=get_worker_logging_config()) as p:
        with tqdm(total=len(pairs), bar_format="{l_bar}{bar:30}{r_bar}") as pbar:
            pbar.set_description(datetime.now().strftime("[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S]") + " PostProcessing  ")
            for _ in p.imap_unordered(PostProcessingParallelWithConfig, pairs):
                pbar.update()

    add_log("End process: xcorr_noise_postprocessing", level="info")
    add_log("#"*50, level="info")
